A closer look at OxyVal L.A.

The product information discusses bacterial-care contexts involving the respiratory system and other farm-animal infections. The relevance of an antibacterial formulation depends on diagnosis, susceptibility where appropriate, the animal’s condition and the locally authorised product instructions.

What is in the formulation?

ComponentAvailable formulation detail
Oxytetracycline, as dihydrate200 mg per ml

The product’s care focus.

  • Oxytetracycline is the named antibacterial ingredient.
  • The supplied concentration is 200 mg/ml, as oxytetracycline dihydrate.
  • Long-acting presentation within the Valerian anti-infective range.

Presentation, route and administration.

Veterinary injection; follow the authorised route and administration precautions for this presentation.

Product-specific directions

A complete product-specific numerical course is not confirmed here. Do not transfer a dose from another oxytetracycline strength or brand; obtain the current directions.

Build a more useful care conversation.

Prepare these details when discussing OxyVal L.A with your veterinary team.

  • Tell the veterinarian the affected species, signs and previous treatments.
  • Confirm the exact concentration and the meaning of the long-acting presentation.
  • Record the prescribed schedule and any required meat or milk withdrawal interval.

Before you take the next step.

What should I request for OxyVal L.A?+

Ask for the current product specification, the available pack size and directions for your species and market. For a commercial enquiry, include your organisation, country and the quantity or documentation you need.

Does a care category establish suitability for my animal?+

No. The exact formulation, animal’s condition and local product authorisation matter. The treating veterinarian should confirm suitability, administration and any applicable food-production withdrawal requirements.

For veterinary professionals. Product information is an overview; the current locally authorised instructions and prescribing veterinarian determine use. Pack presentation may vary.
